name: Yorokobi Akihiko
source:
Yorokobi Akihiko is the kind of person who can easily get along with anyone. Not only is he always worried about others' wellbeings, but he can be really cute when he wants to!

Initially, he's a really calm person... but his quest on successfully confessing to his crush could drastically change things!

[From [url=https://stefannofornari-games.itch.io/dont-give-up-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
